title: Eliminate circular dynamic import in drawerStore and prune obsolete mock stages
summary: Resolved Vite circular/dynamic import warning where boardStore was dynamically imported inside drawerStore while statically imported elsewhere, refactoring drawerStore to use standard static store access. Pruned obsolete 5-stage mock data (review/retro/architect/developer/reviewer/retro/release) from mockData.ts, aligning INITIAL_CORTEX_STAGES with the canonical 3-stage agile architecture (backlog, dev with cvh-dev, ready). Confirmed clean isolation of copilotStore and copilot components.
